name: Home Assistant
description: Native Home Assistant display for LEDMatrix with searchable entity discovery, smart entity presets, visual color controls, calendars, real-time priority notifications, and configurable wide-matrix scrolling.
author: airbornetrooper82573

versions.notes: Add smart presets based on Home Assistant domain/device class: automatic units, friendly state labels, garage/presence handling, and suggested person/vehicle/package/animal/motion notification wording.
Add searchable Home Assistant entity discovery with one-click add actions, visual color pickers instead of typed hex values, masked token/URL widgets, and easier alert state filters.
Add native live-priority notification takeover, per-rule priority, global/per-item text colors, and per-item scrolling controls.
Initial release with REST entity/calendar cards, WebSocket state-change notifications, wildcard rules, cooldowns, and wide-matrix scrolling.

widgets.name: ha-entity-browser
widgets.description: Search Home Assistant entities and add them to entity, calendar, or notification configuration.

web_ui_actions.title: Test Home Assistant Entity Discovery
web_ui_actions.description: Queries Home Assistant using the configured URL and token. The Entity Browser above uses this same backend.
